_comment: Single source of truth. Anything in [square brackets] is an unconfirmed placeholder that Julia must supply before launch — see TODO.md. Never invent a value here.
_businessName_note: The practice name — the site title, the nav lockup, og:site_name and the JSON-LD MedicalBusiness name all come from here. It must stay byte-identical to the Google Business Profile listing: conflicting name signals actively reduce confidence in the listing. Confirm with Julia before launch.
name: Julia Comstock-Ross
_url_note: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the real domain before launch. Used for canonical, OG and sitemap URLs.
_contact_note: phoneHref is the tel: digits. Templates fall back to a marked placeholder if either is emptied, so never blank one without blanking the other.
_image_note: Both null until real assets exist. ogImage should be a 1200x630 PNG at /assets/img/og-default.png; appleTouchIcon a 180x180 PNG. A broken og:image is worse than none, so the tags are only emitted once these are set.
_booking_note: Julia's SimplePractice Client Portal. Deliberately the portal root rather than /request: the root offers both 'I'm a New Client' and 'Contact', so it stays valid whatever she configures inside SimplePractice, and it is the URL SimplePractice treats as canonical. Every 'Book a free intro call' button on the site — nav, hero, sticky CTA, every cta.njk block — reads this value. Empty it and they all fall back to /contact/.
_serviceArea_note: UNCONFIRMED — Julia must confirm which of these she will actually drive to, and add any missing. This list feeds the JSON-LD areaServed and should match the Google Business Profile service area exactly.
travelRadius: No additional mileage charge within the service area.
_travelRadius_note: Julia supplied this with a question mark attached ('no additional mileage charge I dont think?'). It is published as a firm no-charge policy — confirm before launch, because a fees page is where families will hold her to it.
_services_note: Both services bill hourly. Consulting is hourly and may run longer than an hour, which the /services/ copy says explicitly.

policies.cancellation: Sessions need to be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance. Inside 24 hours the full session fee is due.
policies._superbills_note: RESOLVED: superbills are issued on request for families to submit for out-of-network reimbursement. Templates read this flag.
policies.paymentMethods: Check, credit card, HSA and FSA.
policies._mandatedReporter_note: Washington law makes a licensed OT a mandated reporter. Stated on /services/ under Confidentiality so it is never a surprise mid-relationship.
